headings.text: Marci Metzger has spent nearly three decades helping people navigate real estate with confidence. Her team pairs deep market knowledge with the hands-on service every client deserves.
Nobody knows the market like a local. From market analysis and upgrade lists to trusted contractors and lending connections, Marci keeps buyers and sellers informed at every step.

findings.message: 1 large-set statement(s) run past 3 lines at 1440px: "Marci Metzger has spent nearly three dec…" → 4 lines at 36px
findings.fix: A statement set large is about 30 words. Cut it, or set the rest as ordinary body text.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Page scrolls sideways by 408px at 1440px. Widest offenders: img (+23px), img (+79px), p.footer-name (+408px).
findings.fix: Constrain the element that is wider than the viewport (max-width: 100%, or overflow: clip on its section).

findings.message: The margins differ: 32px on the left, 0px on the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: 2 stretch(es) of the page hold nothing at all: 420px at 1540px; 528px at 6088px (the screen is 900px tall).
findings.fix: Close the gap: a section gap is 120–240px on desktop and 72–112px on a phone. Look for a min-height: 100vh on a short section, an empty grid row, a hidden element still holding its space, or a reveal that never fired. A deliberate rest is a placed picture or colour field, not nothing.

findings.message: Page scrolls sideways by 217px at 768px. Widest offenders: small (+13px), img (+44px), img (+100px).
findings.fix: Constrain the element that is wider than the viewport (max-width: 100%, or overflow: clip on its section).

findings.message: The h1 is a bare name ("MARCI METZGER") and nothing else on the first screen says what this is.
findings.fix: Keep the name if it leads, and give the line under it (18px or more) the plain words: what it is, for whom, where or when. In the study of 97 Sites of the Day, first screens that named nothing lost usability and content points.

findings.message: 2 headline(s) wrap past two lines at 390px: "PROVEN IN PAHRUMP" → 3 lines (3 words, 46.8px); "PAHRUMP, NEVADA 89048" → 3 lines (3 words, 32.8px, a paragraph set above 24px)
findings.fix:
Cut words first (a headline is a title, not a sentence). Then give it a wider measure. Lower the size only as a last resort and never below the scale you chose. A real statement paragraph belongs in a

or

at 24px or less.
Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.

findings.message: The page sits off-centre: its content comes to 0px from the left edge but only to 42px from the right, at 390px.
findings.fix: Give the page one pair of equal margins. Check the wrapper for a max-width without margin-inline: auto, a grid with an empty last column, or padding on one side only. If one side is meant to hold air, it must still be closed by something that reaches the margin (a picture, the navigation's last item, a figure).

findings.message: A section carries text but no heading: section#about.about-section at 3606px.
findings.fix: Name it with a short heading unless it is the continuation of the section above.
